keywords.name: dragforce
keywords.description: If on (the default), the drag force of each element is output during coupling. Otherwise, a null drag force is output for all elements.

keywords.name: porosity
keywords.description: If on (the default), the porosity of each element is output during coupling. Otherwise, a unit porosity is output for all elements.

examples.description: Output the drag force during coupling

verification: Live-verified 2026-11-09 on PFC3D 6.00, 7.00 and 9.8 consoles (syntax grade): dragforce and porosity accepted on all three consoles.
